answer: Anchor each identity to a registered marble quarry. Every epoch the quarry's seismograph signs a fresh blast log — charge weight, delay pattern, and the karst bedrock's unique seismic echo — on the public ledger. One quarry supports one identity: two identities sharing a blast signature collapse into a single vote and burn their bond. A wharf-side inspector samples the stone, confirming a working quarry, not a paper claim. Forging a hundred votes means buying and blasting a hundred real quarries, each with permits, crews, and licences, while an honest agent only files its own blast log once.
